description: Source code implementing a sample rbus server with registration of objects, method handling, and element management, including callback functions for get/set operations and a main function that orchestrates connection, registration, and cleanup.

methods.description: Handles set requests, extracts payload string, copies it into user_data, and initializes response with success code.

methods.description: Generic callback invoked upon message reception, converts message to debug string, prints it, and frees buffer.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Main function establishing broker connection, registering objects and methods, adding elements, and handling cleanup upon user input.
